_meta.notes: Very faint PENCIL entries on a 2004-vintage form (Column B is headed 'Year-to-Date Total', not 'Sum Total to Date'); cells were re-rendered up to 900 dpi. Line 1 Column A is written '1400' + a wide gap + '00' with NO visible decimal separator - recorded as '1400.00' at medium confidence (Line 4 repeats it the same way, and Line 3 + Line 4 = Line 5 checks out: 8300.39 + 1400.00 = 9700.39). Line 1 Column B likewise shows no decimal separator; best reading '24,684.55' but the cents pair could be '88' - low confidence. Line 2 Column B best reading '21457.05', low confidence. Lines 3-7 carry a written '$' which is kept verbatim. INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY: Line 2 Column A reads '2043.85' but Line 6 (which should copy it) reads as '2443.85'/'2643.85' over a heavily struck-out earlier entry, and Line 5 - Line 7 (9700.39 - 7056.54) implies 2643.85; the form's own Line 2 figure is recorded verbatim at low confidence and NOT corrected.
